reply.text:
Shoulders respond to a few things done consistently. Press overhead or on an incline for the front delts, and add lateral raises for the side delts, which are what give you width. Rear delts get hit with face pulls or reverse flyes, and most people under-train them. Aim for roughly 10 to 20 hard sets a week across those, spread over two or three sessions, with most sets finishing 1 to 3 reps short of failure. Add a rep or a little weight over time, and eat and sleep enough to grow.

If you want, I can build you a program with a shoulder focus. Just tell me how many days a week you can train.
